Jordan (Partner Success): Quick sync — Orbit partner asked for a clear SEV path for marketplace+hardware+SI incidents. Can we outline a short playbook and shared-channel cadence?
Alex Patel: +1. We should avoid duplicate war rooms. proposal: single shared channel #orbit-partner-sev, with an ops war room link for high-sev.
Maya Rivera: agree. suggest roles: partner-liaison (Jordan), oncall-eng (rotate), si-lead (Sato), infra-sre (Linh).
Sato Watanabe: I can be SI lead for initial rollout. what's the trigger threshold for opening a war room vs handling in-channel?
Alex Patel: threshold idea — Sev1 (service down / data loss) -> immediate war room + pager. Sev2 (degraded perf) -> shared channel + oncall pager if not acked in 15m. Sev3 -> async in shared channel.
Linh Nguyen: +1. also add automatic fallback to a lighter model if capacity issue (for hosted models tied to Orbit HW) — noted in routing policy.
Jordan (Partner Success): Partner asked for a single escalation matrix they can share with their oncall. I'll draft a one-pager. Need contact table and handoff checklist.
Alex Patel: putting a quick contact matrix below. feel free to tweak.
Alex Patel: ```
Role | Name | Slack | Pager
Partner liaison | Jordan (Partner Success) | @jordan-partners | ---
SI lead | Sato Watanabe | @sato | +1-555-01-SATO
Oncall eng | Redwood oncall | #oncall-rotations | PagerDuty
Infra SRE | Linh Nguyen | @linh | +1-555-01-LINH
Marketplace ops | Maya Rivera | @maya | ---
```
Maya Rivera: add war-room link template: https://zoom.us/j/000000000 (replace with dedicated bridge) and a shared doc link with runbook.
Jordan (Partner Success): I'll create #orbit-partner-sev and add Orbit contacts + SI reps. plan to run a drill next week.
Sato Watanabe: drill sounds good. propose run at 10am PT Thursday. I'll coordinate with SI team.
Linh Nguyen: ops-bot will post reminders; also we'll add a monitoring alert rule that tags channel on sev1.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: SEV drill for #orbit-partner-sev on 2024-11-07T17:00:00Z — @Jordan (Partner Success) confirmed. :bell:
Alex Patel: handoff checklist (short): 1) create war room link if sev1, 2) post issue summary + primary impact, 3) assign SI lead & oncall, 4) capture mitigation steps in doc, 5) post postmortem owner within 48h.
Maya Rivera: +1. add note about data access: Orbit hardware logs live in partner-s3 (read-only for us) — include log export step in runbook.
Jordan (Partner Success): will draft runbook snippet, aim to share by EOD today. can someone add the alert that routes to #orbit-partner-sev?
Linh Nguyen: I'll add the alert. ping me the metric name.
Sato Watanabe: metric is orbit_gpu_temp_alert and orbit_service_heartbeat. I'll DM the details.
Alex Patel: one more: set a fallback policy in routing: if dedicated capacity unavailable, auto-failover to compatible quantized variant of model and notify channel. keeps customer live.
Jordan (Partner Success): great. next steps: Jordan to post the one-pager + invite list, Linh to wire alerts, Sato to schedule drill, Alex to update routing policy docs. meeting-free sync here — add any blockers.
Maya Rivera: +1. tagging Orbit PM (cc @OrbitPM) to make sure partner sees the plan once posted.
Alex Patel: thanks all. keeping the thread short — will post PR for the routing doc tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Jordan (Partner Success): thanks team — will follow up with invites and doc links.
